name: print-social-black-and-white-club-night-posts-with-outlined-type-and-stamp-graphics
title: Three black-and-white club posts with giant ghost outline type, lineup lists, sparkles and a tomato radio stamp
whatItIs: Three Instagram posts on pale grey with faint giant outline lettering behind: a white lineup post with stepped black label blocks and sparkle stars, a black 'UPCOMING EVENT IN DRUGSTORE' post with outlined and solid words, and a white 'PARADAJZ RADIO SHOWCASE' post with a black tomato-shaped stamp logo and 'MAIN STAGE'.
whatItMeans: Underground and graphic; stark black and white with ghost lettering feels like a zine flyer.
techniques: Set giant outlined lettering as texture.
Stack lineup names in black label strips.
Use sparkle glyphs and a stamp logo.

vocabulary.definition: Giant outlined letters at low contrast.
Artist names on black label bars.
A logo shaped like a rubber stamp.
A set of posts in black and white only.
